main_text.p: nii & ad summa qvæq; nati ἐγχειρήματα. Quantus assurgere author cum libuerit qvam, graviter, vehementer, granditer dicere possit, ex hoc specime non conji-cere, sed asserere licet. Itaque duplici nomine mihi fuit hoc munus gratissi-mum, & qvod amicitiæ erga me tuæ μνημοσυνον honorificum, & qvod elo-qventiæ nitidissimæ & ornatissimæ, quâ maxime oblector, insigne sit monumen-tum, tuis præterea litteris admonitus, clarissimum virum Rigaltium adii. qvi eruditissimam Epistolam, qvam Paulo ante illi rescripseras, mihi legendam mutuo dedit. Tertuliani fragmentum istud o-stenderat mihi Reverendissimus Aurelia-nensis Episcopus, cùm primùm Parisios Roma allatum est; te autem minime cæ-labo, qvid mihi tunc dictaverit animus, suppositum Tertuliano fœtum existima-bam, ita etiam censebat doctissimus ille Episcopus, sed in charta Donationis ni-hil adulterini suspicabar. page.notes: The page number reads "28" followed by a damaged final digit, taken as 9; marked [?]. The Greek word ἐγχειρήματα and μνημοσυνον are transcribed from the scan and are not checked against a source. The catchword "ta," is the first word of the next page. The final word "compara-" continues onto the next page as "compara-ta". No doubtful readings elsewhere on the page.
